cmd.help:
LeviSchematic Commands:
  /schem ui - Open the Litematica-style main menu (M / F7)
  /schem ui <main|load|placements|placement|selection|settings|keys|materials|survival|tasks|hud> - UI pages
  /schem ui layout - Export the last completed menu frame geometry
  /schem ui <world|projects|signs> - P4 workflow pages
  /schem world <paste|gridpaste|fill|replace|delete|clone|move> - Select actual-world tool
  /schem world <prepare|start|pause|resume|cancel|status> - Preflight and task control
  /schem world offset <dx dy dz> | policy <air|nonair|all> | sample <primary|secondary>
  /schem project <create|open|rename|save|work> <name>; checkout <version>; list|status|paste|cancel
  /schem sign <copy|copyback|paste|cancel> - Next native sign editor paste
  /schem ui status - Show C++ UI backend and lifecycle diagnostics
  /schem ui <save|layers|verifier|session|resources|edit> - Open a workflow page
  /schem resource <status|save|reload-discard|cancel> | saveas <file> (.levischematic|.litematic|.mcstructure)
  /schem edit set <x y z> <block> - Edit shared schematic content
  /schem grid enabled <bool> | grid <x|y|z> <spacing> <negative> <positive>
  /schem selection normal <bool> | add <name> | region <id>
  /schem save <file> - Queue progressive world selection capture (no overwrite); no extension saves .levischematic, .litematic/.mcstructure select those formats (.mcstructure merges multiple regions)
  /schem save-status | save-cancel - Inspect/cancel selection capture
  /schem verify <start|layers|stop|reset|info> - Selected placement verification
  /schem layer mode <all|single|range|below|above> - Set layer mode
  /schem layer axis <x|y|z> | boundary <value> | info
  M: menu; Ctrl+Alt+S: save; M+V: verifier; M+PageUp/PageDown: layer mode
  /schem load <file> [x y z] - Queue schematic load (.levischematic, .litematic, .mcstructure)
  /schem load status <taskId> - Show load progress
  /schem load cancel <taskId> - Cancel an unfinished load
  /schem config reload - Validate and apply config.json on next tick
  Config: projection.color RGBA tint; hull.missingColor/blockColor/propertyColor/extraColor; hull.alwaysShowMissing, hull.alwaysShowExtra (default ON); tool.item (minecraft:stick)
  /schem config save - Save effective/pending configuration
  /schem move <dx> <dy> <dz> - Move placement
  /schem origin <x> <y> <z> - Set origin
  /schem rotate <cw90|ccw90|r180> - Rotate
  /schem mirror <x|z|none> - Mirror
  /schem list - List placements
  /schem select <id> - Select placement
  /schem remove [id] - Remove placement
  /schem toggle [render] - Toggle placement state
  /schem info - Show placement info
  /schem block hide <x y z> - Hide a projected block
  /schem block set <x y z> <block> - Override one projected block
  /schem block clear <x y z> - Clear one block override
  /schem files - List available files
  /schem convert|convert-overwrite <source> <target> - Convert between .levischematic, .litematic and .mcstructure (blocks only; multiple regions are merged into .mcstructure)
  /schem convert-status | convert-cancel - Inspect/cancel the file conversion
  /schem reset - Reset transform
  /schem clear - Clear placements and cancel unfinished loads
  /schem pos1 [x y z] - Set selection corner 1
  /schem pos2 [x y z] - Set selection corner 2
  /schem selection clear - Clear selection
  /schem selection mode - Toggle selection mode
  /schem selection info - Show selection info
  /schem view y min <value> - Set minimum visible Y and enable filtering
  /schem view y max <value> - Set maximum visible Y and enable filtering
  /schem view y range <min> <max> - Set visible Y range and enable filtering
  /schem view y enable - Enable Y range filtering
  /schem view y disable - Disable Y range filtering
  /schem view y info - Show Y range filter state
  /schem renderer stats - Show preview state and block-entity highlight routing
  /schem renderer reset - Release preview resources; keep placements and rebuild next frame
